description: Category chart component tag contract. Flat tags define the chart to generate: its chart type, whether categories and series are fixed (labels/names supplied here) or AI-generated, count boundaries and targets, value formatting, and optional per-axis authoring guidance. There is no config object tag. Chart-shape validation, workbook data, and rendering are out of scope for this contract.

efficio_component_type.description: Identifies this shape as a category chart component.

efficio_chart_type.description: The category chart type to render.

ai.purpose: The category chart type to render (a 2D column/bar family type).

enum_descriptions.CLUSTERED_COLUMN: Vertical columns grouped side by side per category.
enum_descriptions.STACKED_COLUMN: Vertical columns stacked to show cumulative totals per category.
enum_descriptions.PERCENTS_STACKED_COLUMN: Vertical columns stacked to 100% to show each series' share per category.
enum_descriptions.CLUSTERED_BAR: Horizontal bars grouped side by side per category.
enum_descriptions.STACKED_BAR: Horizontal bars stacked to show cumulative totals per category.
enum_descriptions.PERCENTS_STACKED_BAR: Horizontal bars stacked to 100% to show each series' share per category.

efficio_category_mode.description: Whether category labels are fixed (supplied in efficio_categories) or generated by the AI.

ai.purpose: Whether the category labels are fixed (reuse the provided categories exactly) or must be generated.

enum_descriptions.fixed: Category labels are provided in this context and must be reused exactly, in order.
enum_descriptions.ai_generated: Category labels are generated within the category count boundaries.

efficio_categories.description: Fixed category labels, in order. Required when efficio_category_mode is fixed; must be omitted when it is ai_generated.

ai.purpose: When category_mode is fixed, the exact category labels to reuse, in order.

efficio_min_categories.description: Lower boundary on the number of categories.

ai.purpose: Lower boundary on the number of categories the chart may have.

efficio_max_categories.description: Upper boundary on the number of categories.

ai.purpose: Upper boundary on the number of categories the chart may have.

efficio_target_categories.description: Intended number of categories to generate, within the min/max boundaries.

ai.purpose: Intended number of categories to aim for, within the min/max boundaries.

efficio_category_instruction.description: Optional guidance for generating category labels.

ai.purpose: Optional guidance for generating the category labels.

efficio_series_mode.description: Whether series names are fixed (supplied in efficio_series_names) or generated by the AI.

ai.purpose: Whether the series names are fixed (reuse the provided names exactly) or must be generated.

enum_descriptions.fixed: Series names are provided in this context and must be reused exactly, in order.
enum_descriptions.ai_generated: Series names are generated within the series count boundaries.

efficio_series_names.description: Fixed series names, in order. Required when efficio_series_mode is fixed; must be omitted when it is ai_generated.

ai.purpose: When series_mode is fixed, the exact series names to reuse, in order.

efficio_min_series.description: Lower boundary on the number of series.

ai.purpose: Lower boundary on the number of data series.

efficio_max_series.description: Upper boundary on the number of series.

ai.purpose: Upper boundary on the number of data series.

efficio_target_series.description: Intended number of series to generate, within the min/max boundaries.

ai.purpose: Intended number of data series to aim for, within the min/max boundaries.

efficio_series_instruction.description: Optional guidance for generating series names.

ai.purpose: Optional guidance for generating the series names.

efficio_value_type.description: Data type of the series values. Only numeric values are supported.

ai.purpose: Data type of the series values; only numeric values are supported.

efficio_value_unit.description: Optional unit describing the series values (for example "%" or "USD").

ai.purpose: Optional unit describing the series values (for example "%" or "USD").

efficio_allow_negative_values.description: Whether series values may be negative. Percent-stacked chart types cannot allow negative values.

ai.purpose: Whether the generated series values may be negative.

efficio_allow_decimal_values.description: Whether series values may be non-integer (decimal).

ai.purpose: Whether the generated series values may be non-integer (decimal).

example.efficio_prompt_instruction: Generate quarterly revenue series for the business units.
